title: Fit and feature expectations
summary: This topic combines comments about the vehicle fitting owners’ needs and isolated complaints about expected storage or equipment, while most fragments are too context-limited to classify confidently.

positive.summary: One positive review says the vehicle works well as a daily driver and compares favorably with another car.

negative.summary: One negative review reports dissatisfaction with missing sunglass storage that the customer expected to have.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention things working perfectly, fitting driving needs, cleaning results, or expected equipment, but they lack enough context for reliable sentiment labeling.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence about the dominant customer view.

The examples mix several loosely related subjects such as daily driving fit, electric range suitability, cleaning quality, storage, replacement parts, and expected tires rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Some undetermined fragments reference other vehicles or missing context, so they cannot be cleanly attributed to a specific sentiment about the G70.
